lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, 15 module files / 8,078+ lines, 14 headline barrier theorems C1-C14 + prove_all = 15 Palomar comparator targets, zero sorry, zero native_decide, autoImplicit = false; verified across 6 independent kernels via lake check --paranoid & lake comparator --paranoid on Ubuntu CI)

core_result: Machine-checks 14 classical complexity-barrier theorems (C1-C14) in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 with Palomar Challenge/Solution isolation (15 comparator targets): Baker-Gill-Solovay relativization (C1-C2), Markov-Fischer bounded-negation theorem & slice monotonicity (C3-C5), Razborov-Rudich natural proofs obstruction (C6), Schaefer polymorphism rigidity (C7-C9), algebraic/multiplicative & catalytic complexity bounds (C10-C13), and permanent-vs-determinant characteristic-2 collapse (C14). Paired with exact CaDiCaL 2.1.2 SAT multiplicative-complexity synthesis cross-checked by exhaustive brute-force enumeration, 4 rigorous falsifiers of aggressive P=NP heuristics (CTDS ODE blowup, rational LP integrality gaps, 3-adic Hensel non-Boolean root, completely rigid |Aut|=1 3-SAT instance), 12/12 cross-OS pytest+Hypothesis tests, 15-page zero-overfull AMS-LaTeX preprint + standalone arXiv tarball, live GitHub Pages Proof Blueprint, and 100.0% (63/63) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
verification_boundary: All 14 classical barrier theorems plus master conjunction (15 audited targets) are 100% kernel-checked in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Explicitly formalizes known barriers and refutes heuristic attacks — makes ZERO claim to resolve P vs NP (Mega-Atlas CS-001) or any open complexity separation. Attack A (CTDS ODE) is explicitly tagged numerical_approximation; no external peer review or external DOI is claimed.
